title: ApplyPilot application command center and reliable CV Studio

phases.name: baseline_and_contracts
phases.notes: Pre-state captured; additive cc_* schema and workspace-scoped API adapters; legacy workflows retained.

phases.name: frontend_workbench
phases.notes: Responsive workspace, themes, CV editor/preview, application records, inbox, insights, and themed embedded legacy pipeline/settings.

phases.name: reliable_cv_updates
phases.notes: Replacement/deletion semantics, structured facts, fingerprints, existing-job regeneration, immutable CV versions, memberships/CPD, and PDF pagination improvements.

phases.name: application_records
phases.notes: Execution events, hiring outcomes, notes, references, evidence, priorities, archive/restore, scoped blocking and legacy unblock, duplicate suggestions, listing checks, and bulk pick/regenerate.

phases.name: live_execution
phases.notes: Authenticated SSE/replay/polling, LLM form events and checkpoint controls, uncertain submission guards, uniquely scoped stopped-attempt release; Claude Code browser tool events and heartbeat instrumentation.

phases.name: ai_assistance
phases.notes: Native Anthropic client and wizard/tier readiness, grounded assistant tasks, revision-aware caching, transactional daily request budgets, measured token usage, verified screening answers.

phases.name: hiring_and_email
phases.notes: Hiring states, message evidence review/deduplication, Gmail/Outlook OAuth PKCE, encrypted tokens, refresh/sync/disconnect, background synchronization, reminders and ICS export.

phases.name: scheduling_and_analytics
phases.notes: Durable scheduled preparation/submission, restart review, bounded daily work, preference/listing checks, queue priority, exclusions, response/source metrics, and CSV export.

commands: ruff check new command-center Python modules --select F
verification.full_gate: 233 tests passed with Playwright enabled; 7 AI regression checks and 13 formal evaluation cases passed; compileall passed
verification.browser_checks: Desktop/tablet/mobile width and full-width editors, certification add/delete, embedded settings, multi-page PDF section extraction, and classic multi-user clickthrough
verification.additional_checks: JavaScript syntax and Python F-rule lint passed
verification.live_integrations: Not run against real AI billing, mailbox accounts, or employer submissions; mocked provider/OAuth contracts and temporary-workspace HTTP/browser checks used.

baseline_note: Pre-state was captured by Windows Python; its Git fields were unavailable because of UNC ownership checks. WSL git status confirmed the existing search-config edits, .env:Zone.Identifier and '=' before runtime changes. These existing user changes were not edited.
setup_dependencies: Rebuild/restart the existing Docker deployment to serve the new code and dependencies
Configure the chosen AI API provider for live assistant/tailoring requests
Register Gmail/Outlook OAuth applications and authorize each mailbox for live synchronization

follow_ups.task: Richer version diff, configurable section ordering/page-length preferences, and document-history workspace transfer portability
Configurable dollar-cost estimates and live reviewer comparisons; task-specific routing delivered by implementation 20261002-task-ai-routing
Opt-in high-confidence automatic updates, historical email backfills, and additional notification channels; reviewed AI classification/date extraction delivered by 20261002-smart-evidence-inbox
Salary/sponsorship preference rules, block-reason preference suggestions, date/cohort analytics, and resume-version outcome associations
